applicability: Sparse family-member updates within one successfully admitted family-side-revision continuation walk.
conditions: A recorded member retains its exact invariant revision and payload identity.
Sources unite by exact claim identity without replacing conflicting content.
Repeated first pages from another walk do not reset that walk; an identical accepted replay is idempotent.
exclusions: A second canonical dataset, traversal policy or cache authority.
Alteration of the latest response primary statement, complete source inventory, evidence or authored assessment.
statement: Within one admitted family-side-revision walk, sparse member updates retain delivered immutable content and unite sources by exact claim identity; replay is idempotent and another walk's repeated first page cannot erase progress.
